Name: FashionSenseOutfits
Author: nihilistzsche
Description:
FashionSenseOutfits adds a Content Patcher endpoint at nihilistzsche.FashionSenseOutfits/Outfits that you can target to change the current Fashion Sense outfit based on Content Patcher conditions and tokens.

It will do nothing on its own, you must have an additional Content Patcher content pack targeting the "nihilistzsche.FashionSenseOutfits/Outfits" endpoint. 

You can change the outfit at the start of a new day, when moving to a new location, or when the time changes down to the hour.

Please see the README.md [url=https://github.com/nihilistzsche/FashionSenseOutfits]here[/url] for more information.

Manifest.Name: FashionSenseOutfits
Manifest.Description: Adds a Content Patcher target to change the current FashionSense outfit through the FashionSense API.
